resources.string: Choose earbuds to show the case, left and right battery levels.
Select one or more devices. The case and both earbuds appear in one card. Connect a device once to save it in the list.
Connect your earbuds and open the case, then tap Refresh. Devices with separate battery levels will appear here.
Could not load battery data. Check Bluetooth and your earbuds connection, then try again.
This Android build does not provide the required system battery data or Google battery widget.
Allow Nearby devices access to hide the card as soon as your earbuds disconnect. If the permission prompt no longer appears, enable access in the app settings.
